data.name: Kingdoms in Arms
data.detailed_description:
Conquer the new world and defeat all those who oppose you in Kingdoms in Arms!

City Management / Builder

Your beginnings on the Island are humble. A simple and small village is all you have to work with at the start. It is your duty to grow this village into the mighty capital that is worthy of the crown. Manage your peoples needs as they are the pillar of your entire kingdom. Promote them to be soldiers to fight on the front lines or let them work the fields and mines to supply the kingdom with resources needed for the conquest.

Real Time Strategy Fighting

Others have landed on the island staking their claim against yours. You have to punish this insurrection and show them who the master of the new world truly is.

Command your squats of infantry, archers and cavalry to out-manouveur your foe. Ambush him from the side or dominate him by sheer force.

Sieges and Map Conquest

Siege or be besieged. That is the name of the game. Fortify your outposts and citys and defend against enemy attacks. At the same time, prepare your counterattacks. Build powerful siege engines, like catapults and trebuchets, to tear down the walls of your enemies and burn down their citys.

Supply Lines and Transport Networks

War is won before the battle begins. Establish supply lines, protect transport routes, and keep resources flowing between your settlements, armies, and front lines. Getting enough supplues to your soldiers at the front is crucial for long lasting battles and sieges. Of course the same is true for your enemies. So ambush their supply lines and starve them our until the surrender their city (We do not take prisoners).

Experience this and more in the coming release of Kingdoms in Arms!

data.short_description: Kingdoms in Arms is a strategy game where you build and manage your kingdom. Build cities, outposts and military camps to conquer the whole island. Besiege your enemies castles and bring down their walls with your siege engines like catapults and trebuchets. Control your armies in real time.

*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Part of the War Mechanic of this game is fighting between armies. These fights have bloody effects and produce bodies.
